HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   B. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

4. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   B. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   B. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   D. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   B. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   D. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   C. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.

9. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   B. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   C. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.

11. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   B. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat National Security as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   D. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Colonial Administration in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Political developments in independent Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

3. B — Nairobi

4. D — Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. D — Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. C — Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A — Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
